mapper.select: SELECT id, permission_code, permission_name, created_at FROM sys_permission
SELECT id, permission_code, permission_name, created_at FROM sys_permission WHERE permission_code = #{permissionCode}

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.permission_code, p.permission_name, p.created_at FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1
